```sql
WITH EligibleSubscriptions AS (
    SELECT s.SubscriptionId
    FROM Subscription s
    JOIN ServicePlan sp ON s.PlanId = sp.PlanId
    JOIN OutageEvent oe ON oe.StationId = s.CustomerId
    WHERE s.StartDate <= '2026-03-31' AND s.dt2 >= '2026-01-01'
```

```sql
WITH OutageEventsWithinRange AS (
    SELECT OutageId
    FROM OutageEvent
    WHERE StartedAt >= '2026-03-01T00:00:00' AND StartedAt < '2026-03-01T08:00:00'
    GROUP BY OutageId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT OE.OutageId) AS OutageCount
FROM OutageEvent OE
JOIN OutageEventsWithinRange OEWI ON OE.OutageId = OEWI.OutageId
WHERE OE.DurationMinutes > 8 * 60
```

```sql
)
```

```sql
WITH EligibleSubscriptions AS (
    SELECT SubscriptionId

    WHERE StartDate < DATEADD(year, 3, GETDATE()) AND dt2 > DATEADD(year, 3, GETDATE())

SELECT COUNT(*) AS SubscriptionCount
FROM Subscription
WHERE PlanId IN (
    SELECT PlanId
    FROM Subscription
    INNER JOIN EligibleSubscriptions ON Subscription.SubscriptionId = EligibleSubscriptions.SubscriptionId
```

```sql
WITH OutageByCause AS (
    SELECT
        Cause,
        COUNT(*) AS OutageCount
    FROM
        OutageEvent
    WHERE
        Cause = 'Weather'
        AND StartedAt >= '2026-04-01' AND StartedAt < '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY
        Cause
),
TotalOutages AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS TotalOutageCount
    FROM
        OutageEvent
    WHERE
        StartedAt >= '2026-04-01' AND StartedAt < '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
    ROUND((OUTageByCause.OutageCount * 100.0 / TotalOutages.TotalOutageCount), 1) AS Percentage
FROM
    OutageByCause,
    TotalOutages
```

```sql
WITH CustomerSubscriptions AS (
    SELECT
        s.CustomerId,
        s.StartDate,
        s.dt2,
        ps.PlanName,
        ps.MonthlyFee,
        ps.DataCapGb
    FROM
        Subscription s
    JOIN
        ServicePlan ps ON s.PlanId = ps.PlanId
)
SELECT
    cs.CustomerId,
    cs.PlanName,
    cs.MonthlyFee,
    cs.DataCapGb,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs2.CustomerId) AS NewSubscriptionsCount
FROM
    CustomerSubscriptions cs
JOIN
    CustomerSubscriptions cs2 ON cs.CustomerId <> cs2.CustomerId
    AND cs2.StartDate > cs.StartDate
    AND cs2.StartDate < cs.dt2
GROUP BY
    cs.CustomerId,
    cs.PlanName,
    cs.MonthlyFee,
    cs.DataCapGb
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs2.CustomerId) > 0
```

```sql
WITH MonthlyOutages AS (
    SELECT 
        DATEADD(MONTH, n, '2026-01-01') AS Month,
        OutageId,
        Cause,
        DurationMinutes,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DATEADD(MONTH, n, '2026-01-01')) AS TotalOutagesInMonth
    FROM 
        OutageEvent
    CROSS APPLY 
        (SELECT n = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY OutageId)) n
    WHERE 
        DATEADD(MONTH, n, '2026-01-01') <= '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    Month,
    Cause,
    DurationMinutes,
    ROUND((TotalOutagesInMonth * 100.0 / SUM(TotalOutagesInMonth) OVER (), 1) AS Percentage
FROM 
    MonthlyOutages
WHERE 
    DurationMinutes = (SELECT MAX(DurationMinutes) FROM MonthlyOutages WHERE Month = DATEADD(MONTH, n, '2026-01-01'))
ORDER BY 
    Month
```

```sql

    SELECT DISTINCT c.CustomerId, c.FullName
```

```sql
WITH CentralStationOutages AS (

    FROM
        OutageEvent

        BaseStation ON OutageEvent.StationId = BaseStation.StationId

        District ON BaseStation.DistrictId = District.DistrictId

        Customer ON District.DistrictId = Customer.DistrictId

        AND Subscription.StartDate <= '2026-05-31'
        AND Subscription.dt2 >= '2026-05-01'
)
SELECT
    OutageCount
FROM
```

```sql
WITH DistrictBaseStations AS (
    SELECT DistrictId, COUNT(DISTINCT StationId) AS BaseStationCount
    FROM BaseStation
    GROUP BY DistrictId
),
DistrictCustomers AS (
    SELECT DistrictId, COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
    FROM Customer
    WHERE flg1 = 1
    GROUP BY DistrictId
)
SELECT d.DistrictName, d.BaseStationCount, d.CustomerCount
FROM DistrictBaseStations dbs
JOIN District d ON dbs.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
JOIN DistrictCustomers dc ON d.DistrictId = dc.DistrictId
WHERE d.DistrictId IN (
    SELECT StationId
    FROM OutageEvent
    GROUP BY StationId
    HAVING SUM(DurationMinutes) / 60 > (
        SELECT SUM(DurationMinutes) / 60
        FROM OutageEvent
        GROUP BY StationId
        ORDER BY SUM(DurationMinutes) / 60 DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH ActiveSubscriptions AS (
    SELECT s.CustomerId, c.FullName
    FROM Subscription s
    JOIN Customer c ON s.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    WHERE s.StartDate <= '2026-01-01' AND s.dt2 >= '2026-01-01'
    AND s.PlanId IN (
        SELECT PlanId
        FROM Subscription
        WHERE StartDate <= '2026-01-01' AND dt2 >= '2026-01-01'
        GROUP BY PlanId
        HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
    )
    AND c.flg1 = 1 -- 企業客戶
)
SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId, FullName
FROM ActiveSubscriptions
WHERE CustomerId IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId
    FROM Subscription
    WHERE StartDate <= '2026-01-01' AND dt2 >= '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY CustomerId
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
```

```sql
WITH DistrictAverageFee AS (
    SELECT 
        District.DistrictName,
        CAST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.dt2 >= DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()) THEN T2.MonthlyFee ELSE 0 END) AS float) / COUNT(T2.CustomerId) AS AverageFee
    FROM 
        Customer AS T1
        INNER JOIN 
        Subscription AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId
        INNER JOIN 
        ServicePlan ON T2.PlanId = T2.PlanId
        INNER JOIN 
        District ON T1.DistrictId = District.DistrictId
    WHERE 
        T1.flg1 = 1 -- 企業客戶
    GROUP BY 
        District.DistrictName
)
SELECT 
    DistrictName,
    CEILING(AverageFee) AS MonthlyFee
FROM 
    DistrictAverageFee
WHERE 
    AverageFee > 7
```

```sql
WITH DistrictBaseStationsRatio AS (
    SELECT 
        d.DistrictName,
        COUNT(bs.StationId) AS TotalBaseStations,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bs.Status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ActiveBaseStations
    FROM 
        District d
    JOIN 
        BaseStation bs ON d.DistrictId = bs.DistrictId
    GROUP BY 
        d.DistrictName
)
SELECT 
    d.DistrictName,
```

感謝您的指正。在 T-SQL 中，使用 `STDistance` 方法時，需要確保地理坐標是以 SRID 4326 的形式提供的。以下是修正後的 SQL 查詢：

```sql

    SELECT TOP 1
        bs.StationName AS BaseStationName,
        d.DistrictName AS DistrictName,

    FROM

    ORDER BY
        bs.Location.STDistance(cast('POINT(121.5 25.1)' AS geography))
)
SELECT
    BaseStationName,
    DistrictName,
    CAST(FLOOR(Distance * 100) / 100 AS INT) AS DistanceInMeters
FROM
    ClosestBaseStation
```

修正的地方包括：
1. 將地理坐標 `POINT(25.1 121.5)` 改為 `POINT(121.5 25.1)`，確保緯度在前，經度在後。
2. 將距離單位從公尺轉換為百公尺，再轉換回公尺，以避免浮點數精度問題。

```sql
        OutageEvent o ON b.StationId = o.StationId
    INNER JOIN 
        BaseStation a ON a.StationId = o.StationId
    WHERE 
        b.Status = 'Active'
        AND o.Cause = 'Decommissioned'
    ORDER BY 
        a.STDistance(b.Location) ASC
    OFFSET 1 ROWS
)
SELECT 
    ds.StationName AS DecommissionedStationName,
    nas.StationName AS ActiveStationName,
    CAST(CAST(nas.STDistance(ds.Location) AS INT) AS VARCHAR) + ' 公尺' AS Distance
FROM 
    DistrictStation ds
WHERE 
    ds.DistrictId IN (
        SELECT 
            DistrictId
        FROM 
            BaseStation
        WHERE 
            Status = 'Decommissioned'
    )
ORDER BY 
    ds.DistrictId ASC,
    ds.StationName ASC;
```

```sql
        d.DistrictName,
        COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS GovCustomerCount
    FROM 
        District d
    INNER JOIN 
        BaseStation bs ON d.DistrictId = bs.DistrictId
    INNER JOIN 
        Customer c ON bs.DistrictId = c.DistrictId
    INNER JOIN 
        Subscription s ON c.CustomerId = s.CustomerId
    INNER JOIN 
        ServicePlan sp ON s.PlanId = sp.PlanId
    INNER JOIN 
        OutageEvent oe ON bs.StationId = oe.StationId
    WHERE 
        d.Boundary.STDistance(geography::Point(25.09, 121.59, 4326)) <= 300
        AND c.flg1 = 2
    GROUP BY 
        d.DistrictName
)

WHERE 
    d.Boundary.STDistance(geography::Point(25.09, 121.59, 4326)) <= 300
ORDER BY 
    dsqc.GovCustomerCount DESC;
```

```sql
        Distance
    OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY
)

    StationName,
    CAST(FLOOR(Distance) AS INT) AS DistanceInMeters
FROM 
    BaseStationsWithDistance

    DistanceInMeters ASC;
```
